blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Choco Mucho overcame its sister team Creamline, 23-25, 25-13, 25-23, 22-25, 15-13, to keep its semifinal hopes alive in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Thursday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Dragged into the decider, Flying Titans came out with a sense of urgency after back-to-back losses for an improved 4-3 record in fourth place. Eya Laure nailed the telling blows in the fifth set to deny Creamline’s comeback attempt for the match point, 14-11 Tots Carlos saved a point, followed by an attack error by Caitlin Viray, who then readily made up for her miscue and […]...
